navigator.job: Own the visual outcome, checkpoint, permissions, resume, and final synthesis.

worker.job: Implement one bounded motion or rendering change and report its mechanical and visual evidence.

coach.job: Reproduce visual feedback and propose one causal task- or harness-level improvement.

gate.job: Independently compare a candidate with the frozen fixture, mechanical checks, permissions, and rollback guardrails.

feedback.observed: The v48 left panel still behaved like a rapidly switching selected-sheep widget rather than a believable enlargement of the active pasture. Frequent bite-target cuts made each subject too brief, while the terminal UFO and completion text remained visibly left of the panel centre.
feedback.expected: Show the actual grazing field enlarged, choose a few representative sheep with nearby flock context, hold each long enough to show real movement, change only after collection, and centre the final UFO plus completion copy across the whole panel.
feedback.evidence: The user explicitly approved the long-lived hero recommendation after asking to see the real grazing view, nearby sheep, and movement for longer; final review called the result very good and named only the terminal centring gap.
feedback.reproduction: At native 700px inspect dark/light representative plus 10/62 hero holds, adjacent hero handoffs, reduced motion, and terminal. Reject a decorative camera actor, bite-speed cutting, a hero disappearing while its HUD is visible, field-camera pose mismatch, non-centred or low-contrast completion copy, or any regression in the accepted map, meter, field lifecycle, theme, and finale.

feedback.observed: The generic frontend-design skill kept being activated even after project-specific motion research had been completed and preserved, adding context without improving the direction.
feedback.expected: Use the preserved green-movement shot contract and measured 700px frames as the motion authority; return to external or generic design guidance only when the project evidence has a named gap.
feedback.evidence: The Obsidian study now contains sourced staging, continuity, typography, timing, rejection, and Gate rules specific to this SVG, while the generic skill contributed no uncovered job in the latest pass.
feedback.reproduction: Inspect the active capability routing and the next motion candidate; frontend-design must not activate, and each motion decision must map to the project shot contract or a measured source defect.

feedback.observed: Several successive turnover fixes improved empty time, endpoint distance, footprint clearance, and bridge speed, but the user still had to identify that the continuous carrier path communicated the wrong identity story.
feedback.expected: For an identity or continuity complaint, inspect the actor lifecycle and adjacent rendered frames before optimizing another coordinate metric; test what story the uninterrupted trajectory communicates.
feedback.evidence: V21, v25, and v26 passed their numeric turnover checks, yet the v26 source still reused one field-slot actor and moved the UFO directly from the outgoing pickup to the incoming drop. The first diagnosis that traced both facts produced the bounded service-cut correction.
feedback.reproduction: For the next actor-identity motion report, require a source lifecycle trace plus pickup-to-next-action frame sequence before proposing a spatial or timing change.

proposals.change_target: replace rapid selected-camera cuts with a live hero pasture camera
proposals.cause: The v48 crop reused the grid but still rendered a separate selected actor and retargeted at spawn and bite events, so it read as a fast status widget rather than a sustained view into the pasture. Its terminal group also inherited the left-region placement.
proposals.candidate_change: Reuse the exact pasture group and duplicate field sheep with their existing movement, pose, head, growth, energy, lifecycle, and ear-tag tracks inside one 190x40 crop at 1.55x. Rank active identities by remaining lifetime plus nearby flock context, hold a bounded hero set through collection, follow actual movement with restrained horizontal reframes, and blank HUD plus footprints during a 0.55-source-second pan before the next hero arrives. Centre the terminal UFO and copy on one grid-aligned level-0 merge.
proposals.discovery_evidence: The renderer already owns exact field keyframes, sheep DOM, pasture cells, selected fullness, and map attribution. Reusing those tracks removes the decorative camera actor and needs no dependency, new simulation, new effect, or full-speed camera-follow subsystem.
proposals.reproduction: Run npm run visual:fixture and npm run check; inspect native and 3x dark/light representative plus 10/62 hero holds, adjacent handoffs, reduced motion, and terminal; compare field-camera actor position, pose, head, and tag; verify bounded hero counts and reframes, exact ten-cell fullness, fixed map, terminal contrast, selected opacity, and 30fps/120fps field continuity; require a fresh independent Gate.
proposals.primary_metric: At 700px the left panel reads as a sustained enlarged window into the live pasture: each hero remains visible long enough to show real travel and nearby sheep, while camera and HUD change subjects together only after collection.
proposals.prediction: Using the exact field instead of a reconstructed selected view and cutting six representative hero shots instead of every bite will slow perceived switching without changing the global animation speed.
proposals.falsification_condition: Reject if the camera does not reuse exact field sheep and pasture tracks; cuts at bite speed; loses the hero while its HUD is visible; reveals mismatched identity, pose, or tag; hides nearby useful context; obscures terminal copy; restores roster geometry; or regresses accepted motion, map, meter, panel, fence, theme, finale, size, runtime, and continuity checks.
proposals.regression_check: npm run check plus a fresh independent visual Gate over live field identity and pose matching, hero selection and holds, handoff synchronization, terminal centring and contrast, dark/light 10/28/62 density, reduced motion, map, meter, selected opacity, and 30fps/120fps field continuity.
proposals.transfer_check: Not applicable; this is a project-specific panel rendering correction.
guardrails: Reuse exact pasture and field-sheep tracks; do not invent a second actor system
Hold each hero until collection and keep representative cuts far below recorded bite count
Keep HUD and footprints blank until the camera reaches the next hero
Keep the fixed map, ten-cell fullness, themes, field motion, and finale unchanged
Use one borderless grid-aligned terminal contrast merge; add no card frame or effect layer
Add no dependency and publish only after explicit approval
proposals.rollback: Restore the accepted v48 82x34 selected crop and left-aligned terminal group while retaining the fixed bite map and ten-cell fullness.

proposals.change_target: project motion diagnosis and Gate evidence order
proposals.cause: The diagnosis treated identity as endpoint separation and timing while leaving the uninterrupted actor and carrier continuity unexamined.
proposals.candidate_change: For future identity or handoff complaints, trace the rendered actor lifecycle and the carrier path first, then inspect adjacent 700px frames for the story they communicate before choosing a numeric spatial or timing metric. Require both semantic continuity evidence and the existing mechanical checks at Gate.
proposals.discovery_evidence: Three accepted numeric corrections did not remove the repeated user perception, while one bounded actor-lifecycle and adjacent-frame trace exposed both the reused slot and uninterrupted carrier path without external research or a new capability.
proposals.reproduction: Audit this v27 diagnosis order and its independent Gate: actor lifecycle and adjacent frames must precede the distance/timing assertion, and the accepted product checks must still run afterward.
proposals.primary_metric: The next project-local identity complaint is diagnosed with lifecycle plus adjacent-frame evidence before another coordinate-only fix is proposed.
proposals.prediction: Checking communicated identity before optimizing coordinates will reduce repeated user corrections without increasing the agent roster, permission scope, or research cost.
proposals.falsification_condition: Reject if the semantic check is subjective without source/frame evidence, duplicates the existing visual Gate without changing diagnosis order, or causes mechanical spatial and timing regressions to be skipped.
proposals.regression_check: Validate evolution state and confirm the independent v27 Gate includes both lifecycle continuity and all existing deterministic guardrails.
proposals.transfer_check: Not applicable; keep this diagnosis rule project-scoped until another project independently reproduces the same gap.

promotions.after: The left panel is a 1.55x live view of the exact running field, six representative heroes remain through collection with restrained route reframes and synchronized handoffs, and the final UFO plus completion copy is centred on a grid-aligned contrast merge.

live_cycle.metric: Native 700x212 dark/light representative plus 10/62 live-field heroes, field-camera identity and pose parity, 0.55-source-second blank-HUD handoffs, reduced motion, terminal centring and contrast, fixed map, ten-cell fullness, selected opacity, and field continuity
live_cycle.rollback_threshold: Roll back if camera sheep or pasture diverge from the field; hero shots cut at bite speed; HUD appears without its framed sheep; terminal copy loses centre or contrast; a roster or decorative actor returns; or accepted motion, map, meter, panel, fence, theme, finale, size, runtime, and continuity checks fail.
live_cycle.evidence: A fresh independent Gate scored v49 20/20 with no blocker. Native and 3x dark/light representative plus 10/62 frames show the exact pasture and field sheep at 1.55x inside a 190x40 crop. Field-camera movement, pose, head, and tag comparisons report zero mismatches across 252 paired samples. Representative heroes 0,4,7,13,15,22 remain through collection and use 24 reframes across 201 bites. First and second adjacent handoff frames keep HUD and footprints blank through 0.55 source seconds, then reveal the framed hero and exact fullness together at 4683ms and 10611ms. The terminal UFO and two lines are centred and isolated from map marks by one grid-aligned level-0 merge. Reduced motion, map, ten-cell meter, terminal cleanup, selected opacity, and 30fps/120fps field continuity remain green. npm run visual:fixture, npm run check, and git diff --check pass; the fixture is 1,975,602 bytes and 44.863 seconds.
